title: CDIF Discovery profile
description: Marked by USE of the enrichment properties cdifDiscovery introduces beyond core: schema:measurementTechnique, schema:variableMeasured, schema:spatialCoverage, schema:temporalCoverage, dqv:hasQualityMeasurement. Name+identifier is a core marker (it fires for every dataset), not discovery. schema:subjectOf is also a cdifDiscovery property but is the catalog-record pointer every CDIF record carries, so it does not discriminate and is excluded. cdifDiscovery is a thin wrapper with no content SHACL.
